sources: NFL.com / team practice and roster updates, Sept. 1
Yahoo Fantasy / current ADP and preseason takeaways, Sept. 1
Rams, Panthers, Commanders practice updates, Sept. 1
meta.note: Draft-day patch. Preserve the master Top-150 except for deliberate emergency overrides caused by major availability changes. Josh Jacobs is on the Commissioner's Exempt List and cannot practice or play, so he is moved to late-round-only territory; MarShawn Lloyd receives a major opportunity boost. Puka Nacua returned to practice and is expected ready for Week 1, reducing the short-term injury penalty. Ja'Marr Chase is managing a hyperextended knee but is expected to play Week 1. Malik Nabers remains day-to-day/noncommittal for Week 1. Ashton Jeanty worked with trainers for the first time since his ankle injury but has not returned to full practice. Jeremiyah Love is roughly 50/50 for Week 1. Jacory Croskey-Merritt returned to field work. Jonathon Brooks is dealing with general soreness while Chuba Hubbard returned to practice; Carolina still projects as a committee. TreVeyon Henderson remains sidelined with an ankle issue and Rhamondre Stevenson has the early role edge. Isiah Pacheco was placed on IR for at least four games, further consolidating Jahmyr Gibbs' early-season backfield control.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.notes: On the Commissioner's Exempt List and cannot practice or play while the process continues. No firm return timetable. Treat as a late-round upside flier only on draft day.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.notes: Immediate opportunity spike with Josh Jacobs unavailable. Current reporting points to Lloyd as the favorite for the largest Green Bay backfield share, though Chris Brooks and Kaleb Johnson remain involved.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.notes: Returned to practice after psoas soreness and is expected to be ready for Week 1. Elite season-long ceiling; the prior short-term injury discount should be reduced.

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.notes: Managing a hyperextended left knee and expected to be limited in practice this week, but Cincinnati expects him ready for Week 1. No meaningful season-long downgrade.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.notes: Still working through the final stages of ACL recovery. Nabers says he feels good but remains noncommittal for Week 1, and the Giants are treating him as day-to-day.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.notes: Worked off to the side with trainers Tuesday, his first field work since the Aug. 23 ankle injury. Progressing, but Week 1 availability remains uncertain until he returns to regular practice.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.notes: High-ankle sprain recovery is progressing, but current reporting puts Week 1 availability around 50/50. Tyler Allgeier has immediate early-season value if Love sits or is limited.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.notes: Returned to field work Tuesday after missing late preseason time with a lower-body/groin issue. Trending positively and still sits atop Washington's depth chart, but Week 1 practice participation matters.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.notes: Still part of a murky Washington backfield behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt. JCM's return to work slightly reduces White's standalone path.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.notes: Worked off to the side Tuesday because of general soreness. Carolina still plans a committee with Chuba Hubbard when both are healthy. Brooks keeps the higher explosive ceiling but durability risk remains.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.notes: Dressed and returned to practice Tuesday after a hamstring issue, improving his Week 1 outlook. Carolina still projects as a Brooks/Hubbard committee or hot-hand backfield.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.notes: Remains sidelined with an ankle injury and has not been cleared for full practice. Rhamondre Stevenson already held the early-down/pass-protection/red-zone edge, so Henderson's near-term role risk has increased.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.notes: Draft-day stock up: expected to open with the lead role in a roughly split New England backfield, and TreVeyon Henderson remains sidelined with an ankle injury.

players.name: Isiah Pacheco
players.notes: Placed on injured reserve with a back injury and must miss at least the first four games. No longer a normal draft target in a shallow-bench league.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.notes: Practiced Tuesday after being activated from PUP following offseason ankle surgery. Trending toward Week 1 readiness and remains a viable late-round big-play WR target.

rbCore.name: Ashton Jeanty
rbCore.label: PROGRESSING / WEEK 1 WATCH
rbCore.note: First field work with trainers since the ankle injury is positive, but he has not returned to regular practice. Keep long-term workload projection elite; price in Week 1 uncertainty.

rbCore.name: Omarion Hampton
rbCore.label: TARGET — DOWN A NOTCH
rbCore.note: Still a breakout target, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season and Keaton Mitchell is emerging as the clear RB2.

rbCore.name: Josh Jacobs
rbCore.label: EXEMPT LIST — LATE ROUND ONLY
rbCore.note: Cannot practice or play while on the Commissioner's Exempt List, and there is no firm return timetable. Do not pay his old RB2 price.

rbBackup.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rbBackup.label: PACKERS LEAD-BACK OPPORTUNITY
rbBackup.note: Jacobs' exempt-list status creates immediate usable volume. Lloyd is the favorite for the largest share, though the role is not guaranteed to be a workhorse.

rbBackup.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rbBackup.label: PREMIUM JEANTY CONTINGENCY
rbBackup.note: Jeanty is progressing but still not in regular practice. Washington remains the preferred contingency if Jeanty is limited or misses Week 1.

rbBackup.name: Tyler Allgeier
rbBackup.label: WEEK 1 UPSIDE — LOVE 50/50
rbBackup.note: Jeremiyah Love is roughly 50/50 for Week 1. Allgeier could carry a significant early workload if Love sits or is eased back.

rbBackup.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
rbBackup.label: RETURNED TO FIELD WORK
rbBackup.note: Back doing drills Tuesday and still atop the depth chart. Health trend improved, though official Week 1 participation remains important.

rbBackup.name: Jonathon Brooks
rbBackup.label: SORENESS / COMMITTEE
rbBackup.note: General soreness kept Brooks to side work Tuesday while Hubbard returned. Keep the upside, but don't treat him as a clean lead-back bet.

rbBackup.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
rbBackup.label: EARLY ROLE EDGE
rbBackup.note: Pass protection and red-zone usage favor Stevenson, and Henderson's ankle absence widens the early-season role gap.

rbBackup.name: Keaton Mitchell
rbBackup.label: CLEAR RB2 / ROLE GROWTH
rbBackup.note: Preseason usage indicates Mitchell is solidifying the RB2 job and could form more of a two-man rotation with Hampton than previously expected.

wrCore.name: Puka Nacua
wrCore.label: ELITE — BACK AT PRACTICE
wrCore.note: Returned to practice after the psoas issue and is expected ready for Week 1. The earlier injury discount should be reduced.

wrCore.name: Ja'Marr Chase
wrCore.label: ELITE — MINOR KNEE WATCH
wrCore.note: Hyperextended knee will limit practice this week, but the Bengals expect him ready for Week 1. Keep him in the elite first-round tier.

wrCore.name: Malik Nabers
wrCore.label: DAY-TO-DAY / WEEK 1 UNCERTAIN
wrCore.note: Feels good but remains noncommittal about Week 1 while finishing ACL recovery. Ceiling stays elite, but availability uncertainty is higher than it looked a few days ago.

wrCore.name: DeVonta Smith
wrCore.label: ROLE EXPANSION
wrCore.note: Still one of the preferred Round 3 WR values in the War Room.

wrBreakout.name: Parker Washington
wrBreakout.label: MULTI-SOURCE BREAKOUT TARGET
wrBreakout.note: Multiple independent draft-day sources flag Washington as a mid-round breakout/value target. Treat around the 6th-7th round as an active target rather than a passive depth option.

wrBreakout.name: Alec Pierce
wrBreakout.label: BACK AT PRACTICE
wrBreakout.note: Practiced Tuesday after offseason ankle surgery. Big-play role and Week 1 trend make him a viable late-round WR target.

qbCore.name: Justin Herbert
qbCore.label: FORMAT VALUE / OL WATCH
qbCore.note: Five-point passing TDs still help, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season. The broader draft-day evidence still supports waiting at QB.

teCore.name: George Kittle
teCore.label: BACK AT PRACTICE
teCore.note: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab. Availability trend remains positive, though age/durability still cap the price.
